mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobseeker_applicant a JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = a.JOB_POSTS_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx}

SELECT jobseekerName, matchScore, ranking FROM ( SELECT ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobseekerName, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS matchScore, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE DESC) AS ranking FROM company_matching cm JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx} ) ranked WHERE ranking <= 3 ORDER BY ranking ASC, matchScore DESC

SELECT ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobseekerIdx, ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS jobseekerName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.HOPE_JOB, '$[0]')) AS hopeJob, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS matchScore, cp.KEYSKILL AS tags, ja.JOBSEEKER_APPLICANT_IDX AS jobseekerApplicantIdx, cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx FROM company_matching cm JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX LEFT JOIN cover_posts cp ON cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX = ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX
JOIN jobseeker_applicant ja ON ja.JOB_POSTS_IDX = cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX AND ja.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX
WHERE jp.COMPANY_IDX = #{companyIdx}
ORDER BY cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE DESC, cm.MATCHING_CREATEAT DESC, cm.COM_MATCHING_IDX DESC LIMIT 3
